verdict.rationale: ADK's own MCP documentation states that an ADK agent can act as an MCP client and use tools from external MCP servers. The GitHub README also lists MCP tools as part of its tool ecosystem, so the product itself delivers this capability. missing for 10: documented detail on connection setup (transports such as stdio/SSE, auth, tool filtering), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: An ADK agent can act as an MCP client and use tools provided by external MCP servers.
Utilize pre-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, MCP tools or integrate existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities
